decision.explanation: The query asks for the language of the television series 'Ardhangini'. The sources identify two distinct television series with this title: 1) 'Ardhangini (2017 TV series)', described in D1S1 as an 'Indian Assamese-language' series (supported by D2S1). 2) 'Ardhangini (2018 TV series)', described in D2S1 as an 'Indian Bengali-language' series. While D3S6 mentions a 'Finnish-language' version, this contradicts the specific details in D1S1 (which places the 2017 series on Rang, not Zee TV, and identifies it as Assamese) and appears to be an error in the source text or a hallucination in the disambiguation page; thus, 'Finnish' is rejected. 'Hindi' refers to a different series ('Ardhangini – Ek Khoobsurat Jeevan Saathi') listed in D3S5, not the primary 'Ardhangini' series implied by the specific year-less query which usually defaults to the most prominent or first-listed, but given the ambiguity, both Assamese and Bengali are valid distinct referents found in the text. The R5 set included 'Hindi' incorrectly as a direct match for the unqualified title, but the text distinguishes it as a separate entity.
